spans.s:
लुल् लुल् (closely connected with rt.
लुड्), cl. 1. P. लोलति, &c., to move
about, move hither and thither, roll about; to stir,
agitate, disturb, make tremulous; cl. 6. P. लुलति,
&c. (for लुडति, see rt. लुड्), to adhere, be attached:
Caus. लोलयति, &c., to set in motion, agitate, dis-
turb, confound, put in confusion.

लुलित, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken, agitated, tossed about,
moved to and fro, moving hither and thither, shaking
about, fluttering, tremulous, heaving, waving, curling,
disturbed, confused, bewildered; disarranged, injured,
destroyed; adhering, coming in contact, touching;
agreeable, elegant (for ललित?).
—लुलित-मण्-
डन, अस्, आ, अम्, having ornaments tossed about in
confusion.

लुलाप लुलाप, अस्, m. (said to be con-
nected with rt. लुल्), a buffalo.
—लुलाप-कन्द, अस्,
m. a kind of plant with a tuberous root (= महिष-
कन्द).
—लुलाप-कान्ता, f. a buffalo cow.
